claims.text: The AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic HEA has a brittle aging window between 550 and 750°C.
High L12 ordering approaching a stoichiometric Ni3Al ratio contributes to brittleness.
Jagged B2/FCC phase boundaries contribute synergistically with L12 ordering to brittleness.
High L12 ordering and jagged B2/FCC boundaries collectively elevate the antiphase boundary energy.
Elevated antiphase boundary energy suppresses dislocation cross-slip and forces planar slip.
Planar slip impinging on boundary serrations produces stress concentrations and initiates cracks.
Aging near 750°C reduces the L12 ordering degree.
Aging near 750°C smooths the B2/FCC phase boundaries.
Reduced L12 ordering and smoother interfaces restore cross-slip and blunt stress concentrations, thereby restoring ductility near 750°C.
The as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 alloy contains a ductile FCC matrix and B2 intermetallic phases.
The as-cast alloy exhibits high elongation.
Isothermal aging at 600°C induces brittleness, whereas aging at 750°C restores ductility.
The peak ordering temperature is approximately 600°C.
Approximately 750°C represents an over-aging condition for this alloy.
Ductility varies non-monotonically with aging temperature and reaches a minimum near 600°C.
The ductility minimum coincides with a maximum in L12 ordering degree.
The ductility minimum coincides with a peak in interface serration amplitude.
The brittle-to-ductile transition occurs when the L12 ordering degree drops below a threshold, suggested as less than 0.6.
The brittle-to-ductile transition also requires interface roughness to decrease below a critical amplitude.
The relative contributions of APBE and SISFE modulation cannot be isolated without directly measuring stacking-fault energies in the ordered state.

contradictions.description: The boundary field supplies a numerical example of an L12 order-parameter threshold (<0.6), while the uncertainty field states that the critical order-parameter threshold is not quantified in the provided evidence. The value is therefore presented more specifically than its evidentiary status permits.
